snippet.title: HAVKERMAN-X Launch Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
After 3 years, HAVKERMAN-X Now has a release date...

NOVEMBER 3RD, 2026. Less than one month from now, you will take to the wasteland and take control.

Wishlist now on steam, link in bio.
